title: Backup
exportBody: All programs, workouts, cardio, measurements and settings in one JSON file.
importBody: Replaces all current data with the data from the file.
importConfirmBody: Current data will be deleted and replaced with the backup.
importError: The file is not a valid backup.
resetBody: Deletes workouts, measurements, cardio and restores the default program.
resetConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. Export a backup first.
